record.one_liner: MrScraper is an AI-powered web scraping platform that fetches pages as HTML, Markdown, screenshots or structured JSON, runs web searches, and runs configurable scraper workflows.
record.auth_notes: The REST API takes a dashboard-created API token in the `x-api-token` header. Marketplace endpoints use `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, which is the same token. The auth page also calls the scheme "HTTP Basic Auth", which conflicts with the header example. The hosted MCP server supports OAuth 2.1 browser sign-in with scopes `scrape:read` and `account:read`. I found no documented OAuth flow for third-party apps on the REST API itself, so OAuth2 applies to the MCP server only.
record.access_notes: The pricing page shows a 7-day trial with 1,000 tokens. The trial requires a card, and billing starts at day 7 or when the tokens run out. The paid plans listed are Essential at $99/month and Enterprise (custom). I found no free tier. The pricing page does not say whether trial accounts get API access, though it says all API requests use a dashboard token. A Startup Program (50,000 free tokens) is mentioned, but its eligibility is not described.
record.blocker: Credentials come only from a card-required 7-day trial or the paid plan (Essential, $99/month). Docs are inconsistent on the auth scheme and the V1 vs V3 API, and I found no rate limit details. The API overview does not state base URLs or the full Platform endpoint list. Only the token-verify host (api.app.mrscraper.com) was confirmed.
